objects.name: CrowdStrike 2026 Threat Hunting Report: Exploitation Window Closes as AI Use Accelerates
objects.description: Gen's H1 2026 Threat Report examines two separate attack chains. One used compromised business inboxes and browser manipulation in a banking-malware campaign, while the other used clipboard hijacking to redirect cryptocurrency payments.
